Name: DE-ClientsCompanies
Description: Extracts the information about what companies have access to what clients.
Statement:
select  cli.Oid as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company
from    CommercialClient cli
            left join CommercialClientCompany ccc on ccc.CommercialClient = cli.Oid 
            left join Company com on ccc.Company = com.Oid
